headline: Euro Area Annual Inflation Climbs to 4.0% in October
summary: Eurostat reported that annual inflation in the euro area rose to 4.0%, up according to the latest euro indicators release.
why: Eurostat is the statistical office of the European Union. Inflation metrics guide European Central Bank policy decisions and drive European fixed income and currency markets.
why_moved: Euro area inflation rising to 4.0% reinforces expectations for the European Central Bank to keep interest rates restrictive.
